snippet.title: KunKunNest // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4240090/KunKunNest

This is a horror type anomaly finding game, where you accidentally enter a strange room where a demon Kun Kun lives for two and a half years. Kun Kun likes to tease people who enter its room. It is capricious, sometimes dancing happily, sometimes crying sadly, sometimes hunting with anger, and sometimes making you laugh.

Developed by
JNTM, KunKunRoom
